paragraphs: CityView sells community development software to municipalities, giving them one integrated system for permitting, inspections, planning, code enforcement and licensing. The company describes the platform as purpose-built for local government.

Permits run their full lifecycle in one system, with electronic plans review, mobile field access and automated workflows configured to a jurisdiction's own rules rather than a generic template. Planning teams track rezoning, subdivision, variance and development applications through review, referral and public hearing. Complaints and enforcement cases connect to the same permits and property data. Licensing covers business licenses, cannabis permits, short-term rentals and animal licenses, with online applications, automated renewals and fee calculation. Residents and contractors submit applications, schedule inspections and pay online at any hour.

The company has focused on software for local governments since 1982. It calls that platform one of the first community development and permitting software platforms in North America. The about page says the business was founded by former local government employees for local government. CityView is part of Harris Computer Systems and Constellation Software Inc. One customer story describes the Town of Bradford West Gwillimbury, Ontario, moving to a fully electronic plan review process while upgrading its CityView technology.
